_comment: Pages served byte-identically at a second URL. Edit the canonical file, then run: python3 scripts/check_mirror_pages.py --sync. Mirrors declare the canonical URL, carry no noindex/refresh, and are excluded from sitemap.xml (generate_sitemap.py reads this file). Added 2026-09-23: the short URL is the AI-Overview-cited one; the long slug keeps serving the same article so its inbound links resolve without a redirect.
